Home.metaTitle: PMMI — Integrated Carbon Steel Manufacturer in Indonesia
Home.metaDescription: PT Permai Metal Indonesia is an integrated steelmaker producing carbon steel slabs and billets with an annual capacity of 1.8 million metric tons.
Home.heroSubheadline: Integrated carbon steel production, engineered to world-class standards.
Home.introBody: From molten iron to finished slabs and billets, PMMI operates a fully integrated steelmaking route within the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park — delivering quality, scale and reliability.
Home.ctaBody: Discuss product specifications, capacity and long-term supply with our team.

About.metaTitle: About Us — PT Permai Metal Indonesia
About.metaDescription: Learn about PMMI's mission, vision, core values and integrated steelmaking capabilities.
About.title: About PMMI
About.intro: PT Permai Metal Indonesia (PMMI) is an integrated steelmaking enterprise dedicated to producing high-quality carbon steel slabs and billets for domestic and international markets.
About.missionBody: To manufacture world-class carbon steel that powers Indonesia's infrastructure and industrial growth, through efficient, safe and sustainable operations.
About.visionBody: To be recognised as a leading integrated steel manufacturer in Southeast Asia — a benchmark for quality, technology and responsible production.
About.value1Body: Uncompromising standards across every stage of production.
About.value2Body: A zero-harm culture built on trust and accountability.
About.value3Body: Continuous improvement in process, efficiency and technology.
About.value4Body: Responsible resource use and long-term environmental stewardship.
About.highlight1Body: Large-scale annual output of carbon steel slabs and billets.
About.highlight2Body: A complete BOF–LF–CCM route under one roof.
About.highlight4Body: Located within the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP).

Production.metaTitle: Production Process — PT Permai Metal Indonesia
Production.metaDescription: PMMI's integrated steelmaking route: molten iron, converter furnace (BOF), refining furnace (LF) and continuous casting.
Production.title: Production Process
Production.intro: Our integrated route transforms molten iron into finished carbon steel through four precisely controlled stages.
Production.step1Body: Hot metal is delivered as the primary feedstock for the steelmaking process.
Production.step2Body: Oxygen is blown through the molten iron to reduce carbon and refine the steel.
Production.step3Body: The ladle furnace fine-tunes chemistry and temperature for precise quality control.
Production.step4Body: Liquid steel is cast into solid slabs and billets in a continuous, stable process.
Production.step5Body: Finished carbon steel slabs and billets, ready for downstream rolling and forming.
Production.facilitiesIntro: A complete set of production, quality and support facilities.
Production.facility1Body: Basic oxygen furnace for primary steelmaking.
Production.facility3Body: Casts molten steel into slabs and billets.
Production.facility5Body: Inspection across the full production line.
Production.facility6Body: Storage and logistics for finished products.
Production.facility7Body: Power, water and gas supply systems.

Products.metaTitle: Products — Carbon Steel Slabs & Billets | PMMI
Products.metaDescription: PMMI produces carbon steel slabs and billets to international specifications for construction, manufacturing and infrastructure.
Products.title: Our Products
Products.intro: High-quality carbon steel, produced to international specifications.
Products.slabSpecs: Low- to medium-carbon grades with controlled chemistry and clean surface quality.
Products.slabDimensions: Thickness 210&230 mm · Width 1,000-1,650 mm · Length cut-to-order
Products.slabApplications: Hot-rolled coil, plate, structural sections and shipbuilding.
Products.billetSpecs: Consistent internal soundness and dimensional accuracy for downstream rolling.
Products.billetApplications: Rebar, wire rod, bar and general construction products.
